name: live-preview
title: Live preview: replaceable parts, overlay store, banner and chat card
description: Replaceable marks a part of a screen the PM may replace live in the viewer's browser (the overlay is temporary: sessionStorage, two hours, one release). The shell shows a « Prévisualisation » banner while overlays are active, with per-key close and an optional « Partager » that proposes the change. previewCardFor turns a boring.preview tool result into a chat card whose click adds the overlay. This part executes no source: the sandboxed frame is a later part.
